classification_label_enforcement.title: Classification Label Enforcement Mode
classification_label_enforcement.description: Whether the document management or collaboration platform enforces mandatory classification labels at document creation or upload time.

documents_with_missing_labels_percent.title: Percentage of Confidential Documents Missing Classification Labels
documents_with_missing_labels_percent.description: The percentage of documents in the confidential document corpus that have no classification label applied, as determined by a scan or audit of the document repository.

informal_labels_detected.title: Informal or Non-Standard Labels Detected
informal_labels_detected.description: Whether documents have been found bearing ad-hoc or informal sensitivity markings (e.g., 'PRIV', 'Internal Only', 'DO NOT SHARE') that do not map to the organisation's official classification taxonomy and therefore cannot be enforced by automated tools.

document_sensitivity_label.title: Document Sensitivity Classification Label
document_sensitivity_label.description: The sensitivity classification assigned to the document or document collection, as determined by the organisation's data classification scheme. Also used to contextualize severity of disposal failures and access control decisions.

access_scope.title: Document Access Scope
access_scope.description: The breadth of the permission grant controlling who can access the confidential document or document collection — whether scoped to named individuals, a defined team, a broad department role, or org-wide.

need_to_know_enforced.title: Need-to-Know Enforcement Active
need_to_know_enforced.description: Whether the access control policy for this document or collection explicitly limits access to personnel with a documented, justified business need, rather than granting access based solely on job title, department membership, or catch-all groups.

external_sharing_enabled.title: External Sharing Enabled on Document or Repository
external_sharing_enabled.description: Whether the document or the repository containing it has external sharing turned on, allowing access by users outside the organisation's identity boundary.

document_level_encryption_enforced.title: Document-Level Encryption Enforced
document_level_encryption_enforced.description: Whether document-level or rights-management encryption (e.g., IRM, DRM, or file-level encryption) is applied to confidential documents independent of storage-layer controls.

storage_encryption_tied_to_classificatio.title: Storage Encryption Tied to Classification Level
storage_encryption_tied_to_classificatio.description: Whether the storage system enforces encryption policies that are specifically scoped to the document's classification label (e.g., confidential-tagged documents are stored in encrypted buckets/volumes).

plaintext_confidential_documents_detecte.title: Plaintext Confidential Documents Detected
plaintext_confidential_documents_detecte.description: Whether a scan, audit, or DLP tool has confirmed the presence of unencrypted confidential documents in accessible storage (physical or logical access yields readable plaintext).

retention_policy_assigned.title: Retention Policy Assigned to Document Class
retention_policy_assigned.description: Indicates whether a defined retention schedule with explicit minimum and maximum retention periods has been formally assigned to the confidential documents data class.

automated_retention_enforcement_enabled.title: Automated Retention Enforcement Enabled
automated_retention_enforcement_enabled.description: Indicates whether an automated system (DLP, records management, or storage policy engine) enforces retention schedules by preventing early deletion and triggering disposal at schedule expiry.

disposal_audit_trail_available.title: Disposal Audit Trail Available
disposal_audit_trail_available.description: Indicates whether the system produces an auditable log of document deletions and disposals, capturing actor, timestamp, document identifier, and disposition method.

last_retention_audit_days_ago.title: Days Since Last Retention Compliance Audit
last_retention_audit_days_ago.description: Number of days elapsed since the most recent formal audit or review verified that confidential documents are complying with defined retention schedules.

deletion_method.title: Deletion Method
deletion_method.description: The method used to delete confidential documents, indicating whether secure overwrite, cryptographic erasure, or only logical/soft deletion is performed.

retained_in_backup_after_deletion.title: Retained in Backup After Logical Deletion
retained_in_backup_after_deletion.description: Indicates whether confidential documents remain present in backup or archive storage after logical deletion from the primary store, extending the exposure window beyond the active lifecycle.

physical_destruction_verified.title: Physical Destruction Verified
physical_destruction_verified.description: Indicates whether printed or physical copies of confidential documents are destroyed using an approved method (e.g., cross-cut shredding, incineration) with documented verification.

destination_jurisdiction_validated.title: Destination Jurisdiction Validation Enforced
destination_jurisdiction_validated.description: Whether a technical or procedural control validates that the destination country or storage region meets data protection adequacy requirements before any transfer of confidential documents is permitted.

transfer_destination_adequacy_status.title: Transfer Destination Adequacy Status
transfer_destination_adequacy_status.description: The data protection adequacy classification of the destination jurisdiction or cloud region where the confidential document is being transferred or stored.

document_contains_regulated_data.title: Document Contains Regulated or Sensitive Data
document_contains_regulated_data.description: Whether the document is classified as containing personal data subject to GDPR, trade secrets, PII, PHI, financial data, or other regulated/sensitive information categories requiring transfer controls and masking before broader sharing.

masking_controls_enforced.title: Masking/Redaction Controls Enforced on Shared Copies
masking_controls_enforced.description: Indicates whether the document sharing workflow enforces automatic or policy-driven masking, redaction, or anonymization of sensitive fields before sharing with lower-trust recipients or external parties.

sharing_trust_level.title: Sharing Trust Level of Recipients
sharing_trust_level.description: Describes the trust tier of the intended recipients of the shared document copy — internal high-trust, internal low-trust (e.g., contractors, broad internal), or external (outside the organization).
